name: Execution Properties
abstract: OMS alignment: `sosa:Execution` is a SOSA/SSN generalization with no direct ISO 19156 (OMS) counterpart; OMS has no abstract superclass unifying Observation, Actuation and Sampling. See the OMS alignment building block (`ogc.sosa.oms-alignment`). This building block defines the set of properties common to any SOSA Execution - the abstract act of carrying out a Procedure using a System. It generalizes the properties shared by Observation, Actuation and Sampling and is not intended to be used directly by itself.
description:
## SOSA Execution Properties

This building block describes the properties common to any `sosa:Execution` - the abstract
act of carrying out a Procedure using a System.

`sosa:Execution` generalizes the `Actuation`, `Observation`, and `Sampling` classes. It is
considered abstract: individual executions SHOULD be typed with one of these concrete
sub-classes rather than with `sosa:Execution` itself.

These properties are independent of the feature model implementation, and are inherited by
more specific building blocks (such as [Observation Properties](../observation-owa/)) rather
than used directly.

$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
description: SOSA Execution
$defs:
  dateTime:
    description: xsd:dateTime lexical form (time zone optional)
    type: string
    format: date-time
    pattern: ^-?[0-9]{4,}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?$
  dateTimeStamp:
    description: xsd:dateTimeStamp lexical form (time zone required)
    type: string
    format: date-time
    pattern: ^-?[0-9]{4,}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$
  date:
    description: xsd:date lexical form
    type: string
    pattern: ^-?[0-9]{4,}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?$
  reference:
    description: An IRI or CURIE, or an embedded (non-empty) object
    oneOf:
    - type: string
      minLength: 1
    - type: object
      minProperties: 1
  instant:
    description: time:Instant with at least one position
    type: object
    properties:
      inXSDDateTime:
        $ref: '#/$defs/dateTime'
      inXSDDateTimeStamp:
        $ref: '#/$defs/dateTimeStamp'
      inXSDDate:
        $ref: '#/$defs/date'
    anyOf:
    - required:
      - inXSDDateTime
    - required:
      - inXSDDateTimeStamp
    - required:
      - inXSDDate
    - required:
      - inXSDgYear
    - required:
      - inXSDgYearMonth
    - required:
      - inTimePosition
    - required:
      - id
  temporalEntity:
    description: Time as a simple xsd:dateTime string, or a time:TemporalEntity object
      (e.g. a time:Interval) when it is not a single date-time.
    oneOf:
    - $ref: '#/$defs/dateTime'
    - type: object
      properties:
        hasBeginning:
          $ref: '#/$defs/instant'
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/2006/time#hasBeginning
        hasEnd:
          $ref: '#/$defs/instant'
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/2006/time#hasEnd
        inXSDDateTime:
          $ref: '#/$defs/dateTime'
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/2006/time#inXSDDateTime
          x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime
        inXSDDateTimeStamp:
          $ref: '#/$defs/dateTimeStamp'
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/2006/time#inXSDDateTimeStamp
          x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTimeStamp
        inXSDDate:
          $ref: '#/$defs/date'
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/2006/time#inXSDDate
          x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date
      anyOf:
      - required:
        - hasBeginning
      - required:
        - hasEnd
      - required:
        - inXSDDateTime
      - required:
        - inXSDDateTimeStamp
      - required:
        - inXSDDate
      - required:
        - inXSDgYear
      - required:
        - inXSDgYearMonth
      - required:
        - inTimePosition
      - required:
        - id
  simpleResult:
    description: sosa:hasSimpleResult is a literal (a JSON value, or a JSON-LD typed
      or language-tagged value)
    oneOf:
    - type:
      - string
      - number
      - integer
      - boolean
    - type: object
      required:
      - '@value'
      properties:
        '@value':
          type:
          - string
          - number
          - integer
          - boolean
        '@type':
          type: string
        '@language':
          type: string
      additionalProperties: false
  required:
    allOf:
    - required:
      - hasFeatureOfInterest
    - anyOf:
      - required:
        - resultTime
      - required:
        - phenomenonTime
      - required:
        - startTime
      - required:
        - endTime
  result:
    oneOf:
    - required:
      - hasResult
    - required:
      - hasSimpleResult
